anomalies.observed: R7 is specified in the netlist and SPICE deck as 20 Ω: its KiCad value is "20" and the SPICE line is R7 Net-_Q2-C_ 0 20. It connects the Q2 collector / MAX3485 DE and /RE node to GND.
anomalies.expected: The design specification states R7 should be 20 kΩ, acting as a weak pull-down on the DE//RE node when Q2 is off.
anomalies.impact: When Q2 turns on during TX activity, the 20 Ω load to GND would draw roughly 160 mA from +3V3 through the BC857, exceeding its 0.1 A rating and likely preventing a valid high on the MAX3485 DE//RE node. This can break serial-servo transmit control or damage/overstress Q2 and R7.

parsed.summary: The design otherwise matches the specification, but R7 is implemented as 20 Ω instead of the specified 20 kΩ, which would overload the auto-direction PNP transistor and compromise MAX3485 enable control in serial mode.
